content_sections.heading: Department of Official Language Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 21034/48/2026-OL(Training) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Department of Official Language notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelors degree in any subject from a recognized University; Officers of Central Government or State Government or Union territories administrations holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or Department; or with five years' service after regular appointment in Level-10 (56100-177500) in the pay matrix or equivalent; Armed Forces Personnel of the rank of Captain or equivalent due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year, with the prescribed qualification and experience Experience: Five years' experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open to officers of Central Government, State Governments or Union territories administrations on deputation Must hold an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service in Level-10 (56100-177500) or equivalent Armed Forces Personnel of rank of Captain or equivalent due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year may also be considered Applicants must be officers who can be spared immediately on selection

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation period, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years Armed Forces officers get deputation terms till release, thereafter may be continued on re-employment terms Armed Forces officers retired before selection are appointed on re-employment basis up to the age of superannuation for civil posts Pay regulated per DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended

content_sections.heading: How Will Department of Official Language Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Information in the bio-data, supported by documents, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Photostat copies of ACR/APAR for 2020-21 to 2024-25, each page attested by a Group 'A' Gazetted Officer Integrity Certificate Certificate that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated Statement of major or minor penalties in last 10 years, or a Nil certificate Cadre clearance in respect of the applicant

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Department of Official Language Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in duplicate in the bio-data proforma at Annexure-II. Attach ACR/APAR copies for 2020-21 to 2024-25, each page attested by a Group 'A' Gazetted Officer. Attach Integrity Certificate, vigilance clearance certificate, penalty statement (or Nil certificate) and cadre clearance. Employer verifies particulars and confirms the officer will be relieved immediately on selection. Send through proper channel to the Under Secretary, Department of Official Language, within 60 days of issue or Employment News publication, whichever is later. Make sure it reaches by 01 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Late, incomplete applications or those without attested ACR/APAR copies or office recommendation are liable to be rejected Officers who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature Forwarding office must certify the particulars and confirm immediate relief on selection Officers already on deputation must be forwarded by parent cadre with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Department of Official Language Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Department of Official Language Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Administrative Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Department of Official Language Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Bio Data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma) of this notice) and send it to Under Secretary, Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, Fourth Floor, NDCC-II Building, Jai Singh Road, Near Jantar Mantar, New Delhi-110001, by through proper channel, to reach by 10 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Matrix Level-11, Rs. 67,700-2,08,700.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelors degree in any subject from a recognized University and five years' experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters; officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with five years' regular service in Level-10 (56100-177500) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to officers of Central Government, State Governments or Union territories administrations on deputation. Must hold an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service in Level-10 (56100-177500) or equivalent. Armed Forces Personnel of rank of Captain or equivalent due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year may also be considered. Applicants must be officers who can be spared immediately on selection.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Information in the bio-data, supported by documents, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation period, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years. Armed Forces officers get deputation terms till release, thereafter may be continued on re-employment terms. Armed Forces officers retired before selection are appointed on re-employment basis up to the age of superannuation for civil posts.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Central Hindi Training Institute, New Delhi.
